Author: rtimothyedwards_19428
Content:
There is a difference between "rad-hard" and "rad-tolerant by design".  "rad-hard" chips are pre-dosed with radiation, are made in special fab processes, are generally used by the military, and are definitely restricted.  These cells are designed on basic well-known principles that mitigate total dose radiation effects, and they aren't even guaranteed to any specific dose because I don't have access to any of that information.

After doing some simulations, it's not even clear to me that the regular standard cells would fail under moderate or even high doses of radiation.  They will definitely start leaking excessive quiescent current, but maybe not enough to invalidate the logic states.
